title: Environment Check Regression
statement: This deployment preflight script has started lying about whether a service is ready. Find and fix the regressions. A blank value is just as missing as an absent one, the missing-variable list should be stable, and the script must never print secret values.

files.name: preflight.py

rubric: Absent, blank, and whitespace-only required values are all reported as missing.
The missing names are stable and readable even when the required list contains duplicates.
A successful preflight returns a concise ready message without serializing the environment or exposing secrets.
The existing script shape remains runnable with Python 3 and no dependency.
curveballs: Actually, let an optional variable be absent without making the preflight fail.
Show the number of missing values before their names.
Accept a tuple of required names as well as a list.
